title: DW McMillan Memorial Hospital
description: dwmmh.org zoominfo.com/c/dw-mcmillan-memorial-hospital/77170917 D.W. McMillan Memorial Hospital is a small rural hospital in Brewton, Alabama, operating since 1954. It provides a 24/7 emergency room, ICU, surgery, obstetrics, outpatient chemotherapy, lab, imaging, and rehabilitation — serving as the main acute-care provider for the county. It has about 39–49 beds and employs roughly 85 staff, generating approximately $15 million in annual revenue. The hospital is part of a small county healthcare system that also runs clinics, EMS, and home health services. It has faced serious financial pressure — a $6 million deficit — but survived after county voters approved a tax increase in December 2025 expected to bring ~$1.8 million per year starting 2027.
